add-column: sso_provider gains one nullable display_name column, a metadata-only catalog change with no table rewrite, bounded by 1s lock_timeout and 5s statement_timeout.
create-table-references: organization_sso_domain is created empty in this migration, so its organization and user foreign keys validate no existing rows and acquire only brief catalog locks under 1s lock_timeout and 5s statement_timeout.
row-level-security: Row security is enabled and forced on the new empty organization_sso_domain table before any row or reader exists, under 1s lock_timeout.
create-policy: Owner-only and deny-stella policies are metadata additions on the new empty organization_sso_domain table, under 1s lock_timeout.
